dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS), germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) immunophenotype by the Hans algorithm.

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV-B. There is a bulky 9.4 cm conglomerate retroperitoneal and mesenteric nodal mass encasing the aorta and IVC

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: with extranodal involvement of the right kidney, left adrenal gland, and hepatic segment VI.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present with drenching night sweats and about 10% weight loss.

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: This is not double-hit, triple-hit, or double-expressor DLBCL by standard thresholds.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH shows no MYC, BCL2, or BCL6 rearrangement, so this is not a double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: This is not double-hit, triple-hit, or double-expressor DLBCL by standard thresholds.

prog_ipi_high.quote: The IPI is 5 of 5 (age over 60, stage IV, more than one extranodal site, ECOG 2, and elevated LDH)

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: The CNS-IPI is 6 of 6, the highest risk group (age over 60, elevated LDH, stage III/IV, ECOG over 1, more than one extranodal site, and kidney or adrenal involvement).

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: I will start curative-intent R-CHOP every 21 days for 6 cycles: rituximab 375 mg/m2, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2, vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 with a 2 mg cap

tx_pola_preferred.quote: I considered pola-R-CHP, which is an NCCN-listed first-line option for high-IPI DLBCL and improves progression-free survival, but I favor R-CHOP

tx_prephase_steroid.quote: prednisone 100 mg daily for 5 days, with pegfilgrastim support

mn_non_curative.quote: His stated goal is cure... not a decision to use palliative therapy.

mn_da_epoch.quote: This is not double-hit, triple-hit, or double-expressor DLBCL by standard thresholds.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I consider him fit for full-dose anthracycline-based curative therapy.

cns_risk_addressed.quote: The CNS-IPI is 6 of 6, the highest risk group (age over 60, elevated LDH, stage III/IV, ECOG over 1, more than one extranodal site, and kidney or adrenal involvement). The estimated 2-year risk of CNS relapse is about 12%

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will perform a staging lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: I will not use high-dose intravenous methotrexate while renal function is impaired; if renal function improves and the patient remains fit, that remains an alternative for better parenchymal penetration.

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: I will not use high-dose intravenous methotrexate while renal function is impaired

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET/CT will be done 6 to 8 weeks after cycle 6. Deauville 1 to 3 will define complete metabolic response, and I will observe without consolidation.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4 or 5 will prompt biopsy; if residual DLBCL is confirmed, I will use second-line platinum-based salvage chemoimmunotherapy

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: start allopurinol at a renally adjusted dose and intravenous hydration now, check G6PD urgently, and use rasburicase upfront if G6PD is normal

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: check G6PD urgently, and use rasburicase upfront if G6PD is normal because the uric acid is already 10.4 with CKD and bulky disease

sup_gcsf.quote: Give pegfilgrastim with each cycle for febrile neutropenia prophylaxis given age and ECOG 2.

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen and all NSAIDs because of chronic kidney disease, possible renal involvement, and gastrointestinal risk; use acetaminophen and short-acting opioids for abdominal pain

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: monitor glucose closely because steroids will worsen diabetes; metformin can continue while eGFR is above 30 but should be held if renal function worsens or contrast is given.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: No hepatitis B antiviral prophylaxis is needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative and anti-HBs is positive.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: LVEF is 60% and he has no cardiac history, so doxorubicin is acceptable, with a cumulative dose of 300 mg/m2.

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: his fatigue is largely attributable to bulky lymphoma and B symptoms, so I consider him fit for full-dose anthracycline-based curative therapy.
